semiconductor_relevance: High — SENTECH Instruments GmbH specializes in equipment for plasma processing and thin film metrology, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SENTECH Instruments GmbH develops, manufactures, and sells advanced equipment for plasma processing and thin film measurement, focusing on applications in semiconductor technology, nanotechnology, and photovoltaics. Their systems enable precise control and characterization of thin films, essential for R&D and production in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Non-contact optical quality control using ellipsometry and reflectometry

regional_presence.China: SENTECH supports Chinese customers with a dedicated sales office.
